name: RamNode Cloud VPS
line: Run KVM virtual servers with hourly billing and root access.

cells.regions: Lite: EWR, LAX, NLX; ATL/SEA availability conflicts
cells.selfhost: Yes; root access, manage the guest OS

work.math: $2 a month VM cap + $2 for an IPv4 address. 100 GB of data sent out fits the 500 GB allowance. Building and deploying are self-managed, and tax is not included.
The VM with 1 vCPU and 1 GiB runs 730 hours at the $2 cap, plus $2 for an IPv4 address. 100 GB of data sent out fits 500 GB, but throughput is untested, and tax is not included.
$5.85 a month is the subtotal for the VM, IPv4 address and volume. The seven-day daily backup adds an amount that is not priced. The $7 example assumes seven full 10 GB copies.
